user.title: Connect to Bryx 911
user.description: Sign in with your Bryx 911 account. Home Assistant registers itself as a device on your account and stores the API key it receives. Your password is not saved.

data_description.url: Leave this unchanged unless you were told to use a different server. Enter the base URL, without /graphql.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Bryx 911
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key for {email} is no longer valid. Enter the password again to get a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Bryx 911 API.
error.invalid_auth: That email and password were not accepted.
error.invalid_url: The server URL must be an HTTPS URL, such as {default_url}.

abort.already_configured: This Bryx 911 account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different Bryx 911 account.

init.title: Bryx 911 options
init.description: Choose which agencies to track. Leave this empty to track every agency you belong to.

units.title: Units
units.description: Choose which of your units in those agencies get a device. Units you join later are included automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Bryx 911 API.

duty_status_failed.message: Could not change your duty status: {error}
